What our PSD template tests establish

Our 14-template test report records opening PSD files, exporting PNG images and saving and reopening PSD and PCraft documents with the PhotoCraft 0.7.0 Linux CLI. Round-trip renders matched the initial engine renders in those tests.

This is not a side-by-side Photoshop rendering test or a desktop GUI certification. The third-party files had missing fonts, and four CMYK files were converted to sRGB for PNG export. Review the PSD compatibility checklist before relying on text appearance or print output.

A practical migration checklist

  1. Keep the original PSD and work on a copy containing representative text, masks and effects.
  2. Compare appearance at full size, edit one important layer, save and reopen the document.
  3. Check the exported image in the intended delivery workflow, including color and font requirements.
  4. List essential extensions and review Photoshop plugin compatibility; a WASM filter is not automatically a substitute for an 8BF, CEP or UXP extension.

Use the PhotoCraft integrations directory for documented automation options. Keep your existing production workflow available until your own files pass these checks.
